prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1177; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my knee, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. We'll keep it to the accident. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas. I was moving over one lane to get to the exit ramp when another vehicle came up alongside me and we scraped sides.
Q: What were you doing right before the contact?
A: I had checked my mirror and saw the lane looked clear. I signaled and started to move over. I felt a bump and heard metal scraping.
Q: Did the other driver say anything or stop?
A: They slowed down, then kept going for a bit before pulling onto the shoulder. We both ended up stopped there.
Q: Were you hurt at the scene?
A: My knee hit the steering column when the car jolted. It hurt right away, but I didn't think it was serious at first.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day and then saw an orthopedic provider a few days later. They mentioned possible ligament strain and ordered imaging.
Q: Are you still having symptoms?
A: Yes. Stairs are difficult, and my knee swells by the end of the day. I've been using a brace and taking it easy at work.
Q: Is there anything you'd like to add about the accident?
A: Only that I was trying to be careful. I'd like the claim handled so I can get my treatment covered.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thanks.
